I don't have any blood glucose reading for October 2, 2026, and I can't pull one from your account right now.

- **Local data:** There are no blood glucose records stored on this machine at all. The only data present is daily step counts for October 1–3, 2026, which I haven't used because you asked for blood glucose only.
- **Account connection:** Neither Google nor Fitbit is connected, so I can't check the remote account for that day.

To look it up, I'd need to connect your Google account, which opens a browser sign-in and asks you to grant read access. Do you want me to start that? Blood glucose data also needs to be included in what you share with the app. If the Google connection doesn't provide it, a Google Takeout export of your data could be imported instead. Also note that Google's health API connection in this setup may expire every 7 days.
